L01.why: Redundant is a less typical positive-purpose descriptor; others fit a trial/test noun

L02.why: Nominal is a niche sense; others are common general descriptors

L03.why: Spurious is a strongly negative word that fits few contexts

L04.why: Borrowed seems least likely as a general quality descriptor

L05.why: Secretive is a narrow trait; others are more general

L06.why: Trivial is oddly flat; others are more qualification-like

L07.why: Ruinous is extreme; others are milder and more versatile

L08.why: Invasive is most specialized; others describe general traits

L09.why: Affordable is a cost word; no stem to tell whether cost matters

L10.why: Hurried is a narrow manner word

L11.why: Unfinished is a state word that fits few contexts

L12.why: Displaced is the odd one among adjectives of composition
